title: GameSettings
description: Terratopia combat balance settings, the single GameData/GameSettings.json file (src/GameEngine/DataClasses/GameSettings.cs). Sourced into CombatEngine.Engine.CombatBalance at startup.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version this file was written against. Managed by the GameData Editor — do not hand-edit.

damageFormula.description: CombatMath.CalculateBaseAmount/CalculateDamageAmount: Base = (ActionPower * powerMultiplier) + (Level * levelMultiplier); Damage = (Base / ((Defense + defenseMitigationConstant) / defenseMitigationConstant)) - (Defense / defenseFlatDivisor).

defaultPowerFactor.description: BasicDamageFunction/BasicHealFunction: fallback power factor when an action's parameters.powerFactor is omitted.

evasionDecayAmount.description: CombatEntity.RegisterEvasion: amount subtracted from Evasion after each successful dodge.

keywordCap.description: KeywordResolver.ApplyKeywordBonuses: per-action keyword bonus cap = min(basePowerFactor * multiplier, basePowerFactor + additive).

cruel.description: +bonus when the target's Hp is at or below threshold of their MaxHp.

empowered.description: +bonus when the actor's Hp is at or above threshold of their own MaxHp.

engage.description: +bonus when the target's Hp is at or above threshold of their MaxHp.

stoic.description: +bonus when the actor's Hp is at or below threshold of their own MaxHp.

growthBonusPerUse.description: GrowthKeyword: power bonus added per prior use of the action.

teamworkBonusPerUse.description: TeamworkKeyword: power bonus added per prior use by either side, scoped to the whole side.

livingDeadReviveHp.description: LivingDeadPassive: Hp the entity is revived with when the passive triggers.
